title: 两颗 LED 串联
summary: 一个电阻点亮两颗串联的 LED：它们的压降叠在一起。
description: 用 9 V 电源点亮两颗串联的 LED：+9 V → 220 Ω → 红色 LED → 绿色 LED → GND。串联时两颗 LED 的压降相加，电阻上剩下的电压决定电流。

cards.title: 两颗灯，一个电阻
text: 这一题没有步骤，**照目标电路图自己搭**：一个 220 Ω，后面依次串红色和绿色两颗 LED。
两颗灯“排队”通过同一个电流。它们会一样亮吗？

cards.title: 压降叠在一起
text: - 两颗 LED 串联，它们的正向压降**相加**：$1.8 + 2.1 = 3.9$ V。
- 电阻上剩下 $9 - 3.9 = 5.1$ V，电流由它决定：
$$I \approx \frac{9 - 1.8 - 2.1}{220} \approx 23\ \text{mA}$$
- 再算上每颗 LED 里约 12 Ω 的小电阻，实际会稍小一点。

cards.title: 搭好，量三段电压
text: - 红色 LED 的**短脚**和绿色 LED 的**长脚**要在同一列（首尾相接）。
- 两颗都要长脚朝 + 那一侧。中间不要接到电源轨上。

cards.title: 带走
text: - 串联 LED 只要**一个电阻**，省电又省元件：同一个电流流过所有灯。
- 代价：电源电压必须**大于所有压降之和**。3 V 的电源连两颗 LED 都点不亮（3 V < 3.9 V）。
- 白光、蓝光 LED 的压降约 3 V，所以 12 V 电源大约只能串三颗。

en.title: Two LEDs in series
en.summary: One resistor lights two LEDs in series: their voltage drops stack up.
en.description: Light two LEDs in series from 9 V: +9 V → 220 Ω → red LED → green LED → GND. In series the two LED drops add up, and the voltage left for the resistor sets the current.
hints: LED1's short lead (cathode) and LED2's long lead (anode) go on the same metal strip.
Both LEDs point the same way: long lead towards the + side.
The whole circuit is one single path; nothing in the middle goes to a rail.

cards.title: Two lights, one resistor
text: No steps here — **build it from the target schematic**: one 220 Ω, then a red and a green LED in a row.
The two lights queue up for the same current. Will they be equally bright?

cards.title: The drops stack up
text: - In series the two forward voltages **add**: $1.8 + 2.1 = 3.9$ V.
- That leaves $9 - 3.9 = 5.1$ V for the resistor, which sets the current:
$$I \approx \frac{9 - 1.8 - 2.1}{220} \approx 23\ \text{mA}$$
- Counting the small resistance of about 12 Ω inside each LED, it comes out a bit lower.

cards.title: Build it, measure three voltages
text: - The red LED's **short lead** and the green LED's **long lead** share a column (end to end).
- Both long leads face the + side. Nothing in the middle goes to a rail.

cards.title: Take away
text: - LEDs in series need **one resistor**, which saves current and parts: the same current runs through every light.
- The price: the supply must be **above the sum of all the drops**. A 3 V supply cannot light even these two (3 V < 3.9 V).
- White and blue LEDs drop about 3 V each, so 12 V runs about three in series.

measurements.ask: Voltage across the resistor (red probe on the +9 V end)
Voltage across the red LED (red probe on the long lead)
Voltage across the green LED (red probe on the long lead)
What happens with a 3 V supply instead?
choices: Neither lights: 3 V is less than the two LEDs' drops added up
measurements.explain: Both need at least 1.8 + 2.1 = 3.9 V to conduct. Below that, no current flows anywhere in the series circuit.

measurements.ask: 电阻两端的电压（红表笔在靠 +9 V 的一端）
红色 LED 两端的电压（红表笔在长脚）
绿色 LED 两端的电压（红表笔在长脚）
如果电源换成 3 V，会怎样？
choices: 两颗都不亮：3 V 不够两颗 LED 的压降之和
measurements.explain: 要让两颗都导通，至少要 1.8 + 2.1 = 3.9 V。电压不够时串联电路里一点电流都没有。

hints: LED1 的短脚（负极）和 LED2 的长脚（正极）要在同一条金属条上。
两个 LED 方向要一致：都是长脚朝 + 那一侧。
整个电路只有一条路径，中间不要接到电源轨上。
